whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Eatero,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.5★ reviews on AIIMS Rd in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online food orders and table reservations.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu gallery, aur location/directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/eatero

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Eatero, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering, your menu items, and location near AIIMS Barista in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?"
